title: shadow-surge-moderator-with-staggered-abort-and-audit-replay
author: Ethan Park
description:
Motivation: We observed two incidents where a burst of shadow traffic (from a large A/B experiment) caused backend saturation on Dedicated pools because shadowing was naively mirroring production QPS. This PR implements a Shadow Surge Moderator: a policy-driven admission controller that throttles, staggers, or aborts shadow requests when capacity or latency pressure is detected, while recording explainable audit artifacts for post-mortem and automated rollback decisions.

What this PR does (high level): 1) Adds a shadow admission controller component to the routing plane that applies per-cohort policies (fraction, max-concurrency, staging-window). 2) Implements staggered abort: when a cohort exceeds tolerance, we transition shadow traffic through a staged backoff (reduce fraction -> stagger -> abort) rather than an immediate kill, to avoid noisy replays. 3) Captures an audit-replay bundle for any staging/abort event (request sample, model variant metadata, KV cache snapshot pointer, short perf profile) so downstream tools (rollback advisor, incident playbooks) have explainable context. 4) Integrates the moderator with the rollout controller so shadow-induced pressure can feed automated remediation recommendations (canary throttle, pause promote, or automated revert). 5) Exposes metrics and traces and adds a lightweight UI slice in the Console under the rollout diagnostics tab.

Checklist: - [x] Design doc: https://linear.app/redwood/ENG-2472/shadow-surge-moderator-design - [x] Unit tests for admission logic and policy parsing - [x] Integration tests with staged abort behavior and replay bundle generation - [x] Added metrics (shadow.throttled.count, shadow.abort.reason, shadow.replay.generated) - [x] Console UI slice (read-only) + docs page detailing playbook examples - [x] Backward-compatible; toggled behind feature flag 'shadow_moderator_v1'

Related work: This complements the cohort-aware shadow drain flow (see pr-883567) but focuses on preventing backend saturation by controlling the shadow emitter rather than relying solely on downstream drains. It also feeds our rollback advisor (ENG-1994) with richer context for automated recommendations.

Commits summary: - feat(moderator): core admission controller and policy types - feat(router): integrate moderator into shadow routing path - feat(collector): replay bundle writer and minimal serializer - perf: non-blocking sampling for replay bundles - ui: console diagnostics slice and read-only timeline - test: unit + integration harness for staged abort scenarios - docs: playbook and operator guide

Changed areas (high level file list): - src/orchestrator/shadow/moderator.go - src/orchestrator/shadow/policy.go - src/orchestrator/shadow/replay_bundle/writer.go - src/router/handler_shadow.go (hook in for admission) - dashboard/console-rollouts/src/components/ShadowDiagnostics.tsx - helm/redwood/templates/feature-flags.yaml - docs/rollouts/shadow-moderator.md

Testing notes: Local integration harness simulates three cohorts with synthetic latency spikes. CI run initially failed on a flaky timing test (integration/staged_abort_test) caused by a rare timer race; added deterministic clock injection and re-ran. Production dogfood in the canary cluster showed the moderator reduced shadow-induced backend CPU by ~42% under a burst while still preserving 95% of shadow samples for replay.

Operational notes and safeguards: The moderator is disabled by default. When enabled it respects per-team quotas and a global safety budget. Staggered abort is conservative by default: fraction drops in 3 steps (0.5 -> 0.25 -> 0) spaced by a configurable staging window. Replay bundles are written to an append-only bucket with size limits and TTL; bundles are indexed and checksumed for reproducible replay.

How rollback advisor uses bundles: When the moderator escalates to abort, it emits an event with the bundle pointer. The rollback advisor evaluates the bundle (perf regressions, error patterns) and can return a suggested action (pause promote, scale up Dedicated, or revert model). Those suggestions are surfaced in the rollout UI with reasoning derived from bundle analysis (latency spike at Xms for model vY with KV hit rate Z).

Backwards compatibility and migration: Policy defaults preserve previous behavior (unthrottled shadow) unless feature flag and policies are explicitly set. Helm chart includes a feature-flag toggle.

Release notes (short): Add Shadow Surge Moderator to control shadow traffic bursts, provide staged abort behavior, generate explainable replay bundles for automated rollback recommendations, and surface diagnostics in Console.

Merge: squash and merge after approval and a successful canary in the staging cluster.

review_comments: Maya Chen: Can we make the staging window configurable per-cohort? Some teams run very short-lived experiments and the default 30s window might be too long.
Author (Ethan Park): Yes — added per-cohort staging_window_ms policy and described behavior in the docs. Default remains conservative at 30s but teams can set 5-10s for short experiments.
Diego Ramos: Replay bundles look large in the integration trace; can we cap with sampling and still keep deterministic seeds for reproducibility?
Author (Ethan Park): Implemented deterministic sampling with a 128-bit seed derived from cohort + rollout id. Added size cap and a 'full_replay' opt-in flag for enterprise audits.
Liam O'Connor: The console slice needs RBAC guard — only rollout owners and SRE should see bundle pointers. Also add a quick action to request an immediate snapshot.
Author (Ethan Park): Added RBAC check and a 'request snapshot' button that triggers an on-demand bundle generation (rate-limited).
Maya Chen: CI flake fixed — added deterministic clock in the integration harness. Approving after green CI.
Diego Ramos: Approving. Verified staging canary numbers and metrics.
release_notes: Introduce Shadow Surge Moderator (feature-flagged) to safely manage shadow traffic bursts and produce explainable replay bundles for rollback recommendations. Adds Console diagnostics and playbook docs.
